answer: Re-attestations are stored in river and falcon lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the trellis graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1969 impostors cost 1916 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear.
